# Clean paper

## Literature review

Early studies reported negative associations (Kirschner & Karpinski, 2010; Junco, 2012). Lau (2017) found that multitasking mattered. Al-Adwan et al. (2020) studied Jordanian students, and a Saudi sample showed sleep effects (Kolhar et al., 2021). Bass (1985) defined the construct.

## Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the manuscript preparation process

During the preparation of this work, the author used Claude in order to draft the review. The author reviewed the content.
